targeting_gate.verbatim_anchor:
This review summarizes the variability and uncertainty 
of methane emission in terrestrial freshwater wetlands in 
relation to hydrological responses, laying the foundation for 
the development of potential strategies to mitigate methane 
emission for wetland management and restoration efforts, 
which will be informative for engineers, ecologists, scien-
tists, researchers, as well as policy makers involved in the 
planning, design, and implementation of wetland manage-
ment and restoration projects.
targeting_gate.rationale: Review optimizes methane emissions by water-table management after selecting wetland; no where-to-implement analysis. Management recommendations retained as referral, not siting.

key_findings: Review optimizes methane emissions by water-table management after selecting wetland; no where-to-implement analysis. Management recommendations retained as referral, not siting.
holds: Screen-only. Water-table emission optima are not restoration suitability envelopes.
